messages:
eli: Observability flag  concat-model (int4) canary showing a cluster of funcall malformed args where multiple tool calls appear concatenated into a single args string. Sample window 3k requests, concat_fail rate 0.5% -> 3.3% after int4 deploy. sending a couple of raw outputs.
ben: paste examples?
eli: ```
{"tool":"lookup","args":{"q":"how to set up redwood client"}}
{"tool":"lookup","args":{"q":"how to set up redwood client"}},{"tool":"lookup","args":{"q":"how to set up redwood client"}}
{"tool":"lookup","args":"q=how to set up redwood client"}...TRAILER
```
priya: that looks like concatenation + trailing suffix. any kernel/token changes for concat handling in quant path?
sasha: check whether streaming boundaries or KV reuse could have merged two responses. also check the serializer on the int4 path (detokenizer).
ravi: quick repro: run `./repro --model concat-model --quant int4 --route /agent/lookup --n 2000 --dump-outputs --kvcache on` and compare with int8.
canary-bot: ALERT: concat-model canary cohort B threshold breached (concat_fail_rate 3.3% > 1.8%). Incident INC-2026-777 created.
ben: repro results: int8 concat_fail 0.6%, int4 3.2%. int4 + kvcache off -> 1.0%. token dumps show boundary tokens differ and sometimes an extra separator token inserted (id ~611). sending dumps to eng-infra.
priya: immediate mitigations: (1) add conservative postprocess that splits multiple JSON-like objects and picks the first valid one, label healed outputs with `heuristic_split=true`; (2) disable kvcache for canary cohort; (3) open kernel triage for detokenizer/packed-int4 boundary.
sasha: agree. also run structured-eval (5k golden toolcalls) to measure how often splitting changes semantics. we need to ensure heuristic isn't hiding a real model regression.
eli: assigning: ben -> push split-healer + metric `split_healer_applied` and label outputs; ravi -> disable kvcache for cohort B; sasha -> run structured-eval and produce schema-pass diffs; priya -> open ONB ticket with dumps.
ben: pushed patch to canary branch and deployed at 1765432128. metric `split_healer_success` added.
canary-bot: NOTE: split-healer deployed to cohort B at 1765432128. Monitoring healer metrics.
sasha: initial impact (first 800 reqs): raw concat_fail 3.2% -> post-healer 1.4% (healer fixed ~57% of failures). disabling kvcache lowered raw failures to ~0.9%.
priya: good short-term. don't promote heuristic to stable. schedule kernel triage and 24h canary window. I'll draft a regression note after structured-eval completes.
eli: thanks all. we'll sync in tomorrow stand with triage updates.
